title: Convite para o parque
grammar: Would you like to…? e respostas Yes, I would / No, thank you
goal: Convide com Would you like to…? e responda com Yes, I would ou No, thank you.
reading: She wants to invite Nico to the lake.
Ela quer convidar Nico para ir ao lago.
Ava asks Ben to join them too.
Ava pede que Ben se junte a eles também.
Ben says no, thank you, because he works.
Ben diz que não, obrigado, porque trabalha.
dialogue: Would you like to join us on Sunday?
Você gostaria de se juntar a nós no domingo?
Yes, I would. Where are you going?
We are going to the lake.
Would you like to bring lemonade?
Yes, I would. I have apples.
Would you like to sit on the bench?
Você gostaria de sentar no banco?
No, thank you. I like the grass.
Não, obrigado. Eu gosto da grama.
Would you like to invite Ben too?
Você gostaria de convidar o Ben também?
pron: Junte would e you num som só: woodjoo.
gram: Você gostaria de se juntar a nós?
Para convite cortês usamos Would you like to.

bench: The bench is near the lake.
O banco fica perto do lago.
